gaps.sentence: At no time ___ the crew aware of the danger.
gaps.explanation: 'At no time was the crew aware' — inverted past simple of be.

gaps.sentence: Seldom does a debut novel ___ so much critical attention.
gaps.explanation: 'Seldom does a novel receive …' — the auxiliary 'does' carries tense; base verb follows.

gaps.sentence: Come ___ it may, the trial must proceed.
gaps.explanation: 'Come what may' — fixed inverted idiom = whatever happens.

gaps.sentence: Only since the redesign ___ the app gained new users.
gaps.explanation: 'Only since the redesign has the app gained …' — perfect inversion.

gaps.sentence: Not since the winter of 1963 ___ temperatures dropped so low.
gaps.explanation: 'Not since 1963 have temperatures dropped …' — the only time from then until now.

gaps.sentence: ___ I known about the change of plan, I would have waited.
gaps.explanation: 'Had I known …' = 'If I had known …' — inverted third conditional.

gaps.sentence: Only by training every day ___ she hope to qualify.
gaps.explanation: 'Only by training every day could she hope …' — inverted modal.

gaps.sentence: No sooner ___ the contract been signed than the rumours started.
gaps.explanation: 'No sooner had … been signed than …' — past perfect with inversion.
